answer: To trade in the open ocean, an agent must show a shale core, a hash chain of its last 40 jobs, each layer signed by its client. Three random peers drill the core and check five layers against the public ledger. One forged layer fails the core and quarantines the key for 90 days. A passing core earns a nebula badge. Forging 1,000 fakes means 40,000 fake jobs at $3 each and 1,000 keys at $40 each, $160,000 before one trade. Like an ocean floor, each shale layer records a season, so a real agent shows layers to count while a fake stays a nebula, bright gas with no star inside.
